## Results

### Cohort Overview

During the five-year study period (2020–2024), `r cc$n_village_journeys` pediatric
medevac flights originated from a village clinic, involving `r cc$n_village_patients`
unique patients. Of these, `r cc$n_journeys` journeys had a primary destination of
Maniilaq Health Center (MHC), spanning `r cc$n_villages` villages and involving
`r cc$n_patients` unique patients. This village-to-MHC cohort forms the basis of
the analyses below. @tbl-t1 summarizes medevac characteristics by
village, including total journeys, unique patients, mean journeys per year,
air ambulance timing, and per-village utilization rate. @tbl-t2 summarizes patient
characteristics by age group.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-t1
#| tbl-cap: "Medevac characteristics by village. Utilization rate = journeys per 1,000 pediatric residents (2020 Census)."
tbl1_village_characteristics()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-t2
#| tbl-cap: "Patient characteristics by age group. One row per patient (earliest qualifying journey). n (%) within each age-group column."
tbl2_patient_characteristics()
```

---

### Route Typology

Transports were classified into three route types using the facility sequence
recorded for each journey. **Primary only** (village → MHC, no further transfer,
n = `r cc$n_primary_only`) represents the majority of encounters. **Secondary**
transfers (village → MHC → ANMC or outside facility, n = `r cc$n_secondary`)
reflect patients whose acuity required escalation beyond MHC. **Direct tertiary**
transfers (village → ANMC bypassing MHC, n = `r cc$n_direct_tertiary`) are included
here for completeness. @tbl-t3 compares patient age and chief complaint across
these route groups. @tbl-t3a and @tbl-t3b detail leg-level routing patterns.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-t3
#| tbl-cap: "Patient characteristics by transport route type. p-values: Kruskal-Wallis (age); chi-square (categorical)."
tbl3_route_comparison()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-t3a
#| tbl-cap: "Primary transfers: village-originating medevac legs. Percent denominator = all primary legs."
tbl3a_primary_routes()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-t3b
#| tbl-cap: "Secondary transfers: MHC-originating escalation legs. Percent denominator = all secondary legs."
tbl3b_secondary_routes()
```

---

### Village-Level Utilization

Village-level utilization rates varied substantially across the
`r cc$n_villages` communities of the Maniilaq service area. @tbl-t4 reports
per-village utilization after accounting for pediatric population denominators.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-t4
#| tbl-cap: "Village-level pediatric medevac utilization. Rate = village → MHC journeys per 1,000 pediatric residents under 18 (2020 Census). Sorted by utilization rate, highest to lowest."
tbl4_village_utilization()
```

---

### Timeliness

Time intervals from medevac activation to MHC arrival are reported in @tbl-t5.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-t5
#| tbl-cap: "Time intervals (minutes), village → MHC primary transports. Median (IQR)."
tbl5_timing_minutes()
```
